parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols mpls interface lo0.0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用MPLS协议。

set protocols mpls label-switched-path t.template: set protocols mpls label-switched-path traffic-eng enable
set protocols mpls label-switched-path t.command: set protocols mpls label-switched-path traffic-eng enable
set protocols mpls label-switched-path t.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程标签交换路径。

set protocols ldp interface lo0.0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用LDP协议。

set protocols segment-routing global-blo.explanation: 配置段路由的全局块范围。

parameters.name: start-label
parameters.explanation: 段路由全局块的起始标签。

parameters.name: end-label
parameters.explanation: 段路由全局块的结束标签。

set protocols isis level 1 wide-metrics-.explanation: 配置ISIS协议级别1仅使用宽度量。

set protocols isis level 1 traffic-engin.explanation: 在ISIS协议级别1上启用流量工程。

set protocols isis interface lo0.0 famil.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set protocols isis interface lo0.0 famil.command: set protocols isis interface lo0.0 family inet address 5.5.5.9/32
set protocols isis interface lo0.0 famil.explanation: 在ISIS协议的指定接口上配置IPv4地址。

set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.0.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.0.command: set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.0 family inet address 10.6.1.1/24
set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.0.explanation: 在ISIS协议的指定接口上配置IPv4地址。

set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0.command: set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0 family inet address 10.4.1.2/24
set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0.explanation: 在ISIS协议的指定接口上配置IPv4地址。

set protocols isis interface ge-3/0/0.0.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set protocols isis interface ge-3/0/0.0.command: set protocols isis interface ge-3/0/0.0 family inet address 10.5.1.2/24
set protocols isis interface ge-3/0/0.0.explanation: 在ISIS协议的指定接口上配置IPv4地址。

set protocols isis level 1 prefix-sid in.template: set protocols isis level [parameter1] prefix-sid index [parameter2] interface [parameter3]
set protocols isis level 1 prefix-sid in.command: set protocols isis level 1 prefix-sid index 50 interface lo0.0
set protocols isis level 1 prefix-sid in.explanation: 在ISIS协议级别1上配置前缀SID索引。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 5.5.5.9/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。
